capabilities.title: Correct deterministic ranking and canonical contracts
acceptance_criteria: PageRank conserves probability mass, all numerics are finite and bounded, identifiers are canonical, and server contracts fail explicitly on invalid input.
capabilities.next_action: Add generated property tests for ranking and every canonical registry.

capabilities.title: Tenant-safe storage, paths, and retained evidence
acceptance_criteria: Every retained artifact is owner-scoped; root replacement, traversal, links, reparse points, unsafe members, and database identity changes fail closed.
capabilities.next_action: Add macOS identity tests and recurring corruption drills.

capabilities.title: Bounded privacy-finalized ingestion
acceptance_criteria: Parsing, OCR, metadata, chunks, uploads, and privacy masking are bounded before durable publication, and partial failures leave recoverable state.
capabilities.next_action: Extend the same boundary to structured tables, formulas, and figures.

capabilities.title: Four-store authoritative lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: Retained source, vector, sparse, and generation state publish compatibly through durable jobs, leases, retries, compensation, and reconciliation.
capabilities.next_action: Complete exhaustive fault injection for replacement, deletion, restore, and publication.

capabilities.title: Lifecycle retention and auditable compaction
acceptance_criteria: Exact-confirmed plans exclude current, leased, unresolved, and rollback-required records; durable intent precedes deletion and receipts make recovery idempotent.
capabilities.next_action: Generalize the graph compaction intent-and-receipt protocol to all lifecycle journals.

capabilities.title: Isolated migration build and cutover preflight
acceptance_criteria: Shadow indexes remain isolated, carry exact identities and benchmark evidence, and cannot cut over when compatibility, rollback material, or confirmations are stale.
capabilities.next_action: Connect preflight to a durable exclusive execution journal.

capabilities.title: Atomic cutover validation and exact rollback
acceptance_criteria: Vector, sparse, and generation publication is atomic or fully compensated; failed post-publication validation restores exact prior identities.
capabilities.next_action: Implement the cutover state machine, exclusive lease, idempotency key, and crash-phase matrix.

capabilities.title: Persistent sparse BM25 retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Postings, field statistics, scores, deletions, and replacements are deterministic, finite, owner-scoped, and generation-scoped.
capabilities.next_action: Benchmark and calibrate field weights on representative corpora.

capabilities.title: Governed dense embedding profiles
acceptance_criteria: Model revision, dimension, normalization, and preprocessing are immutable profile identity, and incompatible query and document vectors never mix.
capabilities.next_action: Promote multilingual and domain profiles through benchmarked manifests.

capabilities.title: Hybrid fusion, RRF, MMR, and source diversity
acceptance_criteria: Dense, sparse, fusion, diversity, and source-cap decisions are deterministic, bounded, traceable, and robust to missing components and score-scale differences.
capabilities.next_action: Calibrate fusion weights and diversity with repeated-seed promotion gates.

capabilities.title: Typed filters and governed reranker cascades
acceptance_criteria: Authority, provenance, date, MIME, field, and section filters apply before truncation, while reranker cascades obey quality, latency, memory, and cost budgets.
capabilities.next_action: Implement the complete filter grammar and a versioned reranker registry.

capabilities.title: Query transforms, adaptive routing, and bounded multi-hop retrieval
acceptance_criteria: HyDE, step-back, decomposition, multi-query, corrective attempts, and subquestion DAGs are bounded, traced, loop-safe, and never confuse generated hypotheses with evidence.
capabilities.next_action: Finish explicit transform policies and benchmark route and hop necessity.

capabilities.title: SPLADE and ColBERT retrieval families
acceptance_criteria: Neural sparse and late-interaction indexes have immutable model identity, bounded representations, full provenance, and equal-budget comparisons against BM25, dense, and hybrid baselines.
capabilities.next_action: Define isolated adapter and index contracts before adding model dependencies.

capabilities.title: Multilingual, domain, Matryoshka, and multi-vector retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Indic and domain profiles, dimension truncation, and multiple vectors per section or modality preserve compatible identity, provenance, fair source caps, and benchmark evidence.
capabilities.next_action: Add governed multilingual profiles, multi-vector aggregation, and cross-lingual fixtures.

capabilities.title: Server-owned citation lineage
acceptance_criteria: The server mints citations only from authoritative retrieved evidence, rejects unseen or cross-owner identifiers, and resolves each citation to an exact source region.
capabilities.next_action: Add stale-generation, swapped-evidence, and model-invented citation tests.

capabilities.title: Evidence sufficiency, confidence calibration, and abstention
acceptance_criteria: Insufficient, contradictory, stale, or untrusted evidence forces bounded corrective retrieval or abstention; confidence is calibrated against support rather than fluency.
capabilities.next_action: Fit and govern domain-specific calibrators with risk-coverage gates.

capabilities.title: Verification-aware revision and constrained evidence packing
acceptance_criteria: Critique separates claim, citation, and retrieval gaps; revision uses only authorized evidence; packing optimizes support, novelty, diversity, authority, and token cost without breaking citations.
capabilities.next_action: Implement a typed verifier and deterministic evidence-packing solver.

capabilities.title: Typed generation-bound evidence graph
acceptance_criteria: Typed nodes and edges retain owner, document, generation, extractor, and source provenance, and invalid or mixed-generation graph publication fails closed.
capabilities.next_action: Add large-corpus construction benchmarks and schema migration tests.

capabilities.title: Fail-closed graph authority and durable reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: Reads verify current pointer, generation, and digest; jobs are owner-scoped, leased, retryable, idempotent, and cannot silently downgrade to stale historical graph state.
capabilities.next_action: Add multi-process contention, pointer replacement, and database identity fault tests.

capabilities.title: Cross-document paths, communities, and derived summaries
acceptance_criteria: Cross-document searches enforce owner, generation, depth, branching, and output limits; communities and summaries remain versioned derived artifacts with source-node provenance.
capabilities.next_action: Benchmark path recall and promote community summaries only after measured gains.

capabilities.title: Exact-confirmed durable graph payload compaction
acceptance_criteria: Exact plan digest and complete candidate set are confirmed; current and authoritative graphs are refused; durable intent, crash resume, idempotency, missing-payload refusal, and receipts are enforced.
capabilities.next_action: Add concurrent-operator, database-replacement, and receipt-corruption fault injection.

capabilities.title: Scientific claim governance and extractor promotion
acceptance_criteria: Claims retain exact spans, uncertainty, extractor identity, append-only reviewer custody, benchmark evidence, promotion gates, rollback, and explicit separation of provenance from truth.
capabilities.next_action: Connect licensed scientific datasets and calibrated entailment review.

capabilities.title: PICO, methods, numerical results, temporal contradiction, and replication
acceptance_criteria: Schemas preserve PICO or PECO, design, method, dataset, limitations, source values, normalized units, intervals, effect sizes, publication time, retractions, contradiction, and replication without rewriting history.
capabilities.next_action: Implement contracts, unit registry, temporal relations, and gold adversarial fixtures.

capabilities.title: Normalized retrieval and evidence evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic corpus, query, and qrels contracts report retrieval, citation, claim support, abstention, calibration, route, multi-hop, latency, cost, and per-query outputs including empty cases.
capabilities.next_action: Split versioned metric contracts and add reference-value fixtures.

capabilities.title: Licensed datasets and immutable experiment matrices
acceptance_criteria: Dataset cards record source, license, checksum, split, leakage, and preprocessing; manifests bind code, data, model, index, policy, seed, environment, failures, and resumable immutable results.
capabilities.next_action: Add SciFact, NFCorpus, TREC-COVID, FiQA, ArguAna, CQADupStack, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue adapters where licensed.

capabilities.title: Statistical promotion and adversarial robustness
acceptance_criteria: Repeated seeds, paired intervals, non-inferiority, practical gain, multiple comparisons, prompt injection, OCR noise, duplicates, stale generations, corruption, tenant isolation, and unsupported citations are measured.
capabilities.next_action: Create one unified adversarial manifest and promotion-gate library.

capabilities.title: Exact-head release proof
acceptance_criteria: Registration, Linux Python 3.10 to 3.12, Windows storage, container, and every platform lock job pass on one unchanged main SHA, and the reporter does not mutate that certified head.
capabilities.next_action: Fix the deterministic Linux full-suite failure and rerun the complete matrix.

capabilities.title: Privacy-safe observability and distributed operations
acceptance_criteria: Traces, metrics, SLOs, queues, leases, idempotency, reconciliation, and operator exports expose bounded hashes, counts, reasons, timings, and policy identity without cross-tenant raw evidence or secrets.
capabilities.next_action: Add bounded trace retention, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, shared queues, and two-worker failure tests.

capabilities.title: Production auth, quotas, object custody, backup, and deployment isolation
acceptance_criteria: Server-derived tenant identity, distributed quotas, SSRF and egress controls, encrypted versioned objects, KMS rotation, backups, restore drills, parser isolation, malware scanning, TLS, and secret management fail closed.
capabilities.next_action: Implement production adapters and disaster-recovery fault drills.

capabilities.title: LegalRAG authority and temporal evidence
acceptance_criteria: Legal evidence preserves jurisdiction, court, date, authority level, citation history, quoted spans, temporal validity, and uncertainty while never presenting retrieval provenance as a legal conclusion.
capabilities.next_action: Define legal schemas and a licensed authority-aware benchmark.

capabilities.title: Biomedical, scientific, and financial specialization
acceptance_criteria: Domain evidence preserves scholarly or filing identifiers, versions, retractions, periods, statements, tables, units, amendments, study quality, and exact source regions with governed domain profiles.
capabilities.next_action: Add licensed domain fixtures, expert review, retraction feeds, and filing-table schemas.

capabilities.title: Layout-aware cross-modal retrieval and citations
acceptance_criteria: Reading order, coordinates, OCR confidence, table cells, formulas, figures, captions, panels, visual embeddings, modality scores, and citations share exact owner, document, generation, and source-region lineage.
capabilities.next_action: Implement modality-aware candidate schemas and a structure-aware benchmark.
